purpose: for the sevenfold prosperity (saptavṛddhi) of the donor's whole family ('thuti sakalayā saptavṛddhi paripūrṇṇa juya māla')
notes: No scribe is named. The phrase 'dānapatihata(ṣāda)janani(!)' before p1's name is corrupt. Its middle part is unclear, but it is presumably part of the description of the dānapati, not a separate person. 'janani' cannot refer to p1, since p1 has a wife. The honorific '-ju' (Newari) is dropped from the names. The cataloguer suggests 'je' for p3's 'ji', so the name could be Jidhaṃ as written. '†karṇṇamahotre†' probably stands for 'karaṇamuhūrte'. NS 960 Māgha śukla 6 falls in January/February 1840 CE. Sun in Makara fits Māgha, and moon in Meṣa fits Aśvinī. This matches the catalogue date of NS 960.
